description: Defines the ContextHostResolver class, a wrapper for HostResolverManager used within the net namespace, providing methods for DNS resolution requests, cache management, and testing utilities.

classes.name: ContextHostResolver
classes.description: A wrapper class for HostResolverManager that manages DNS resolution requests and cache, with additional testing utilities.

methods.name: ContextHostResolver
methods.description: Constructs a ContextHostResolver with a given HostResolverManager or takes ownership of one, along with a ResolveContext.

methods.name: OnShutdown
methods.description: Handles shutdown procedures for the resolver.

methods.name: CreateRequest
methods.description: Creates a DNS resolution request based on provided host information and parameters.

methods.name: CreateMdnsListener
methods.description: Creates an mDNS listener for a specified host and query type.

methods.name: GetDnsConfigAsValue
methods.description: Returns the DNS configuration as a dictionary value.

methods.name: SetRequestContext
methods.description: Associates a URLRequestContext with this resolver.

methods.name: GetManagerForTesting
methods.description: Returns the managed HostResolverManager for testing.

methods.name: GetTargetNetworkForTesting
methods.description: Returns the network handle for testing.

methods.name: LastRestoredCacheSize
methods.description: Returns the number of host cache entries restored.

methods.name: CacheSize
methods.description: Returns the current number of entries in the host cache.

methods.name: SetHostResolverSystemParamsForTest
methods.description: Sets system parameters for the host resolver during tests.

methods.name: SetTickClockForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom TickClock for testing purposes.

methods.name: resolve_context_for_testing
methods.description: Provides access to the internal ResolveContext for testing.
